name: Razorwind Canyon
summary: Dustwind harpies threaten travelers on Razorwind Canyon’s road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. The rocky gulch cuts through Durotar, and the harpies make the route north toward the Horde capital dangerous.

sections.title: A Threat on the High Road
sections.body: Razorwind Canyon runs beside the main road from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar. Its gullies reach into the eastern bluffs and west toward Tor'kren Farm. Dustwind harpies nest among the rocks and attack travelers who stray too close to their roosts. With the canyon so near the capital’s trade route, Durotar’s defenders must keep watch over its gullies.

sections.title: Passages and Ravines
sections.body: Razorwind Canyon’s winding passages cut through Durotar’s red rock hills. An eastern branch runs deep into the crags, through a cavern, and into Drygulch Ravine. Harpies roost on high perches and descend in flocks, so travelers crossing the passes can be surrounded and cut down.

faq.answer: Razorwind Canyon runs along both sides of the main road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar in central Durotar. It has entrances north of Razor Hill, near Tor'kren Farm, and through a cave leading to Drygulch Ravine.
Dustwind harpies inhabit Razorwind Canyon. They nest in the gullies and rocky outcroppings and prey on unwary travelers.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about this canyon?
faq.answer: The Horde is concerned because Razorwind Canyon borders the main trade and travel route between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar. The nesting harpies harass couriers, supply caravans, and other travelers on the central road.

faq.q: Does Razorwind Canyon connect to other areas?
faq.answer: Yes. Razorwind Canyon opens onto the main road and has trails west toward Tor'kren Farm, as well as an eastern cavern leading into Drygulch Ravine.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you know clearing Dustwind harpies from Razorwind Canyon helps keep the main road between Razor Hill and Orgrimmar safe for couriers and fresh recruits.
As an orc, you know harpies nesting beside Durotar’s central road threaten the security of your homeland. Young warriors must cull their numbers.
